description.value: A 65-site BC Parks campground in the Cariboo/Central Interior with full amenities including showers, potable water, and reservations — a comfortable overnight along the Crooked River corridor; opening date depends on snowmelt, so confirm before an early-season visit.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Crooked River Park as a real, open, 65-site campground located 70 km north of Prince George on Highway 97, consistent with the OSM capacity tag. Reservations are explicitly confirmed via the BC Parks reservation system. The OSM operator tag ('Quartz Contracting' with a personal AOL email) is inconsistent with the official BC Parks management evident on the website, which is a concern worth flagging.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Crooked River Campground' but the official BC Parks website names it 'Crooked River Park'.

OSM operator tag is 'Quartz Contracting' with email northquartz@aol.com, inconsistent with the official BC Parks government website — may indicate a contractor managing reservations/operations rather than the park operator, or an outdated/incorrect OSM tag.
Phone number (+1-250-964-3489) and email (northquartz@aol.com) are not confirmed by the BC Parks website content; they appear to be for the contractor (Quartz Contracting), not BC Parks directly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible BC Parks campground with confirmed reservations and year-round gate access, suitable for touring cyclists passing through the Prince George corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The sanitary dump station confirmed via OSM tag (sanitary_dump_station=yes); not corroborated by website content. Internet access explicitly tagged as 'no' in OSM.
